title: abies × insignis var. speciosa
intro:
Abies × insignis var. speciosa, commonly known as Fraser's Fir, is a hybrid coniferous tree that belongs to the Pinaceae family, resulting from the cross between Abies amabilis and Abies bifolia.

Fraser's Fir has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and providing relief from anxiety and stress. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Fraser's Fir include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
